input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: Duplicated PR #17262 (same --checks-only fix, opened ~10 minutes into this run): the open-PR search came after implementing, not before. Consolidated by rebuilding on its branch and keeping only the merge-base fix.
First rebuilt push needed a force push, which was refused; used an -s ours merge of the superseded tip instead (tree unchanged).

doc_friction.issue: changedText diffed against origin/main's tip, so once main moved on, main's new files counted as the branch's (30 platform/ci files on an untouched branch); fixed in this PR.

Backlog held only owner rows again; and two process runs picked the same top ungated friction row (venture-preflight) within minutes. The PR search should come before implementing, which the prompt says ('check open PRs before you start') but this run did it after.

deviations.why: Most PRs carry a new post; a second post on the exact topic of PR #17262's post would be near-duplicate.
deviations.result: One post covers all three faults.

notes: Critique mode; security queue, IDEAS.md and website requests empty. main_health on main 272/272 (full 96.7 s, --checks-only 44.7 s idle). Whole --skip-build pass on 1099-k-threshold-checker: 155 s when the tip diff misread platform/ci as touched, 96 s with --checks-only. Merge-base diff verified after git fetch --deepen=60 (lists only the branch's 3 files). node --test venture-preflight.test.mjs 22/22. No backlog ids touched.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: profile a CLI, find a git-diff base bug, fix with fallback, consolidate with a parallel PR, write a post section

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
